name: Expanded Task Text (ETT)
teaser: Knowledge is power, unfortunately Nikita doesn't see it that way.
description_html:
Features and Usage

Features

Adds extra information to tasks.

  • Shows key(s) required for the task if applicable.
  • If the task is required for collector.
  • If the task is required for lightkeeper.
  • Shows the next quest(s) in the chain
  • Gunsmith tasks list all required parts and what trader(s) sell those parts
  • If applicable shows the time gate until next gunsmith task unlocks.

Usage

Just install it!

Additional Details

If you find any issues, open a Github issue here and I’ll see what I can do.

This is a re-release with permission of the original author, Dirtbikercj

Installation

Extract zip and drop user folder inside of your SPTarkov folder

Demonstration Video (this is for SAIN, but the same concept applies to all of my mods). Credit to Drakia for the video

Credits

Original Mod by Dirtbikercj. Re-posted with permission.

Please show him lots of love. I’ve agreed to handle maintenance going forward but he’s the real creator. He’s given a lot to this community and deserves all the credit and praise, and none of the grief that’s been shown him in the past. I hope he makes his way back to modding but I wish him the best regardless.
